steps.name: Environment persistence and tool validation
steps.description: Idempotently create /etc/profile.d/aiimage_node_env.sh (requires sudo) to expose npm global bin at runtime and set NODE_ENV default without overriding an explicitly set value. Verify sudo availability, ensure workspace exists, validate node/npm presence and minimum majors (node >=14, npm >=6) and emit their versions for operator visibility. Atomic write performed via local temp file and sudo mv to avoid quoting/race issues. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98493/AIImageRecognitionService.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98493/AIImageRecognitionService"
# Ensure workspace
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
# Ensure sudo available for /etc changes
if ! command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "sudo not available: cannot write /etc/profile.d" >&2; exit 2; fi
# Validate node/npm and report versions
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 3; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 4; }
NODE_V=$(node --version 2>/dev/null || true)
NPM_V=$(npm --version 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "node version: ${NODE_V:-unknown}"; echo "npm version: ${NPM_V:-unknown}"
# Check major versions (simple major parse)
node_major=${NODE_V#v}; node_major=${node_major%%.*}; node_major=${node_major:-0}
npm_major=${NPM_V%%.*}; npm_major=${npm_major:-0}
if [ "$node_major" -lt 14 ]; then echo "node >=14 required, found $NODE_V" >&2; exit 5; fi
if [ "$npm_major" -lt 6 ]; then echo "npm >=6 required, found $NPM_V" >&2; exit 6; fi
# Prepare profile content atomically
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/aiimage_node_env.sh
TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMP" <<'SH'
# AIImageRecognitionService environment defaults
# Do not override explicit NODE_ENV; default to development only when unset
export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"
# Add npm global bin to PATH at runtime if available and not already present
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NPM_G_BIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/bin)
  if [ -n "$NPM_G_BIN" ]; then
    case ":$PATH:" in
      *":$NPM_G_BIN:") ;;
      *) export PATH="$PATH:$NPM_G_BIN";;
    esac
  fi
fi
SH
# Install atomically with sudo
sudo mv "$TMP" "$PROFILE" || { echo "failed to move $TMP to $PROFILE" >&2; rm -f "$TMP" || true; exit 7; }
sudo chown root:root "$PROFILE" || true
sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE" || true
# Minimal success output
echo "env-01: profile written to $PROFILE"

steps.name: Validation: build app, start mock API, verify endpoints, stop cleanly
steps.description: Build the React app (NODE_ENV=production npm run build), start the mock API using nohup and capture its PID reliably, validate that the PID corresponds to the mock_api/server.js node process before proceeding, poll /health, POST a small test file to /recognize, then gracefully stop the mock API verifying PID ownership before kill. Rotate stale PID files to avoid killing unrelated PIDs. Operates in workspace /home/kavia/workspace-code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98493/AIImageRecognitionService.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/recipe-finding-app-98606-98493/AIImageRecognitionService"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG="$WORKSPACE/.logs/mock_api.log"
PIDFILE="$WORKSPACE/.logs/mock_api.pid"
# Build with explicit production NODE_ENV
NODE_ENV=production npm run build --silent
[ -d build ] || { echo "build output missing" >&2; exit 11; }
# Rotate stale pidfile if it exists but process absent
if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
  OLDPID=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -n "$OLDPID" ] && ps -p "$OLDPID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "validation-05: existing mock API running (pid $OLDPID), aborting to avoid conflict" >&2; exit 12
  else
    rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true
  fi
fi
# Start mock api with nohup and record pid
nohup node mock_api/server.js >"$LOG" 2>&1 & echo $! >"$PIDFILE"
sleep 1
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then echo "mock API pidfile missing" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" || true; exit 13; fi
PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
# Validate PID is a node process running our server
if [ -z "$PID" ] || ! ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "mock API did not start (PID $PID)" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" || true; rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true; exit 14; fi
# Confirm command line contains mock_api/server.js
if ! grep -q "mock_api/server.js" /proc/$PID/cmdline 2>/dev/null; then echo "PID $PID does not appear to be mock_api/server.js" >&2; tail -n 200 "$LOG" || true; kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true; exit 15; fi
# Ensure cleanup verifies ownership before killing
cleanup(){ if [ -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then PID2=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [ -n "$PID2" ] && ps -p "$PID2" >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -q "mock_api/server.js" /proc/$PID2/cmdline 2>/dev/null; then kill "$PID2" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; if ps -p "$PID2" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -9 "$PID2" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; fi; rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true; fi }
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
# Poll /health
RETRIES=30
SLEEP=1
OK=0
